headline: Names a post office in Sierra Madre, California, after Louis Van Iersel.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 61 South Baldwin Avenue in Sierra Madre, California, as the "Louis Van Iersel Post Office." It is a naming measure only and does not change how the post office operates or what services it provides. The summary does not describe who Louis Van Iersel was.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on July 29, 2016, and the renaming took effect on that date.
